selection.cold_anchor: same strict optical, Gaia, cold CMD and external-reference exclusion used by conditional_calibration.py
selection.forest: three separate 300-tree quantile forests; min_samples_leaf=20, max_features=0.75, bootstrap=false, random_state=20261028
selection.training: fit each A/B/C tier on all eligible development-training anchors; also fit matched-common-training comparison forests for A/B/C
selection.input_route: optical color box from A training 1st to 99th percentiles; within each available tier require its own tenth-neighbor 95th-percentile support in that tier's colors; prefer C then B then A
selection.calibration: no center correction; six groups: development training r-z tertiles, then observed r median within each color group; split-CQR nonnegative 68% and 95% expansion on independent route-calibration field; fallback to global offset if a group has fewer than 80 calibration anchors
selection.final_evaluation: all three newly registered fields, no field removal by count or performance; report direct and calibrated metrics, color/depth bins, spatial blocks and complete-route acceptance

field_choice_basis: high Galactic latitude from sky coordinates and DR11 south sweep filename existence only; no new-field source rows or model residuals inspected before registration
